scope: Saved-scene geometry catalogs, physical component count, bounded target correction, black-rubber parameter replacement and source-bound example selection recovery

backend.kind: Real Python modules and Flask clients against temporary projects; AI/transport mocked; scene inspector tests execute real local Blender

frontend.kind: Actual app HTML/JavaScript in jsdom with controlled APIs; no browser pixel audit

real_blender_inspection.scene: Synthetic cabinet with four tires split across eight opaque-named mesh objects

static_checks.kind: HTML references, ARIA reference integrity, JavaScript syntax and CSS parsing; no pixel/browser accessibility audit
static_checks.preservationExampleInPlaceholder: 例如：反光柔和一点，颜色和角度不变

notes: Full target identification uses actual isolated evaluated geometry and real local material pairs; no object-name similarity or shared material grants edit permission.
Counts derive from all connected surface components and conservative spatial grouping, not imported object names. Every bound material pair must receive the requested assignment.
Seeded catalogs use a separate immutable source identity. Verified seed objects are inspected first, followed by geometry-size candidates within the same bounded page budget.
Zero-area surfaces remain unresolved without aborting valid targets. Caps and ambiguous material slots remain explicit limitations.
Model schema and target correction share at most two requests; no automatic provider/model upgrade and GPT-5.5 remains blocked.
Black rubber checks preset/color/explicit metallic values; switching material type clears incompatible retained defaults.
Material no_change must follow a complete grounded zero-diff patch; an empty model declaration does not prove that four requested tires already match.
Only scene inspection and synthetic flow are verified with real Blender. The user cabinet and live model response require that project archive for acceptance.
Two original missing-fixture errors remain errors; they are not counted as passes.
